title: Referrer-Policy sends full URLs (unsafe-url)
description: The Referrer-Policy header is unsafe-url. Browsers then send the full page URL, including its query string, to every destination, which can carry tokens or identifiers to third parties.
remediation: Immediate: send `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin` (or a stricter value) instead of a policy that forwards full URLs. Durable: set the policy once for the whole origin and remove per-page overrides, since a single page that lowers it affects every link a user follows from there. Trade-off: analytics and affiliate flows that read the full referrer stop receiving the path; use an explicit query parameter where a partner needs that attribution.
limitation: Header value check: it cannot see which URLs carry sensitive query strings.
